steps.title: At most one run per 500 ms
steps.titleZh: 每 500 毫秒最多执行一次
steps.text: The button's click handler is wrapped in `forgeThrottle(…, 500)`. The first click counts at once. Any other click in the next 500 ms is ignored, not saved for later.
steps.textZh: 按钮的点击处理函数被包在 `forgeThrottle(…, 500)` 里。第一次点击立即计数；接下来 500 毫秒内的其他点击都会被忽略，而不是留到以后再执行。

steps.title: Five clicks at once
steps.text: This button clicks **Click repeatedly** five times in a row, far less than 500 ms apart. Only the first click gets through, so the count goes up by one.
steps.textZh: 这个按钮连着点五次**连续点击**，每两次之间远不到 500 毫秒。只有第一次点击能通过，所以计数只加一。

action.run: const button = document.querySelector('h1 + button'); for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) button.click()

steps.title: Ignored calls are not queued
steps.titleZh: 被忽略的调用不会排队
steps.text: This button makes a new throttled function with the page's own `forgeThrottle` and calls it six times. Calls 1 to 5 come at once: only call 1 runs, and the ignored calls return `undefined`. Call 6 comes 600 ms later, after the interval, and runs. Calls 2 to 5 never run later.
steps.textZh: 这个按钮用页面自己的 `forgeThrottle` 新建一个节流函数，调用六次。第 1 到第 5 次同时到来：只有第 1 次执行，被忽略的调用返回 `undefined`。第 6 次在 600 毫秒后到来，这时间隔已过，于是执行。第 2 到第 5 次之后也不会补上。

action.run: const run = forgeThrottle(() => 'ran', 500); const call = (n) => console.log('call ' + n + ': ' + (run() ?? 'ignored')); for (let n = 1; n <= 5; n++) call(n); setTimeout(() => call(6), 600)

steps.actionLabel: Call a throttled function six times

steps.title: It keeps this and the arguments
steps.text: The call that gets through runs with the same `this` and arguments, so a throttled function can be a method. Here `player.move` is throttled: the first call moves the player to 10; the second comes at once, is ignored and returns `undefined`.
steps.textZh: 被放行的那次调用会保留原来的 `this` 和参数，所以节流函数可以当作对象的方法。这里 `player.move` 被节流了：第一次调用把玩家移到 10；第二次紧跟着到来，被忽略，返回 `undefined`。

action.run: const player = { name: 'player', move: forgeThrottle(function (x) { return this.name + ' moved to ' + x; }, 500) }; console.log(player.move(10)); console.log(player.move(20))

steps.actionLabelZh: 先调用 player.move(10)，再调用 player.move(20)

steps.title: Click as fast as you can
steps.text: Click **Click repeatedly** on the page as fast as you can: the count goes up at most twice a second, however often you click. When you stop, nothing more happens: the ignored clicks are not run at the end.
steps.textZh: 在页面上尽可能快地点**连续点击**：不管点多快，计数每秒最多加两次。你一停下，就不会再有任何变化：被忽略的点击不会在末尾补上。
